name: The Gnarlspirit Pack
inspire: Immediately after removing a spirit token from a friendly fighter, Inspire that fighter.
generalRules: Uninspire: Immediately after giving an Inspired friendly fighter a spirit token, Uninspire that fighter.

reactions.name: Spirit Tokens
reactions.rulesText:
Immediately after picking a friendly fighter to use a Core ability, you can remove that fighter's spirit tokens. Immediately after resolving a Core ability for a friendly fighter, you can give them a spirit token. Friendly fighters with any spirit tokens cannot be Inspired or hold treasure tokens.

Sarrakkar Unleashed: This fighter has +2 Move while they have any spirit tokens.

Gorl Unleashed: This fighter has +1 Save while they have any spirit tokens.

Kheira Unleashed: This fighter's melee weapons (excluding Upgrades) have +1 Attack dice while they have any spirit tokens.

Lupan Unleashed: Rolls of {icon:surrounded} count as successes in Attack rolls made for a friendly Lupan while they have any spirit tokens.

abilities.name: In Control
abilities.trigger: Use this in your Power step.
abilities.rulesText: If there are any friendly Inspired fighters on the battlefield, push each friendly Uninspired fighter up to 1 hex. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Self-command
abilities.trigger: Use this in your Power step.
abilities.rulesText: Pick a friendly Uninspired fighter. Remove that fighter's spirit tokens and then give them a Guard token. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Surfaced Instincts
abilities.trigger: Use this in your Power step.
abilities.rulesText: Pick a friendly fighter. Save rolls for that fighter cannot be affected by Cleave ({icon:cleave}) and Ensnare ({icon:ensnare}) in the next turn. You can only use this ability once per game.

playstyle: Four Darkoath beast-warriors with solid 4-Health bodies but modest saves, led by a mobile Sarrakkar who gains Fly when Inspired. Their signature engine is spirit tokens: after any Core ability a fighter can turn feral and gain an Unleashed bonus such as extra Move, Save or Attack dice, but cannot hold treasure while feral. Shedding those tokens Inspires the fighter, so the pack keeps switching between savage bursts and sharper inspired profiles. Games are won by timing these shifts, unleashing for brutal attacks, then reverting to Inspire and claim objectives.
